videos.title: Squad up
videos.by: Hype cut by Jamie · 37 seconds · clean audio (v2)
videos.note: Kids and coaches on voice comms mid-match, then the win, then the end card: EKUZO, Your squad's on. It's vertical, so Reels and Stories run it as is. The feed cuts crop the top and bottom of the striped background.

usedIn.E0: proposed: the welcome bridges back to the ad they saw, so it opens with a still from this video
usedIn.E1: proposed: a thumbnail of the video under "how a season works", linking to it

variants.label: A · Your squad's on
variants.primary: Your kid already plays. Season 01 gives them a squad: same teammates every week, a coach, a season to play for.
variants.headline: Your squad's on
variants.why: Echoes the video's own end card, so the ad, the headline and the video all land on one line.

variants.label: B · Gaming either way
variants.primary: They're gaming either way. What if it counted? Season 01 is a coached esports league for ages 9 to 17.
variants.headline: What if it counted?
variants.why: Our lead parent line from the ad tests. The video brings the hype, the words bring the reassurance.

variants.label: C · Not just randoms
variants.primary: Online friends are great. Teammates are better. Same squad every week, a coach, a season to play for.
variants.headline: Same squad, every week
variants.why: For the parent who worries their kid only plays with strangers. Pairs with the Online friends landing.

flags: In Reels the burned-in captions sit about 64 to 73% of the way down, partly under Instagram's account name and caption. Moving them up about a tenth of the frame clears it.
The last shot says "Online or in the room" over kids in a classroom. Season 01 is remote, so for Season 01 ads either end on the online shot or confirm in-person is part of the offer.
The 1:1 crop trims the top of the coach's camera circle around 0:09. 4:5 keeps everything.

crops.1x1: set a little low to keep the last caption
